brand_identity.name: Salon de l'Épargne et de l'Investissement du Mali (SEIM)
brand_identity.tagline: Bâtir le Patrimoine de Demain : Épargne, Investissement et Innovation Financière en Afrique
brand_identity.tone: Institutional Premium, Modern African Financial, Authoritative, Editorial & Kinetic
brand_identity.theme_strategy: Light & Deep Navy Hybrid - High contrast deep navy blue (#0B132B / #0F172A) with vibrant amber-gold (#F59E0B / #D97706) energy accents, crisp bone/white (#F8FAFC) card surfaces, generous whitespace.

rules: Headings (H1/H2) must never use default Inter.
H1 Hero size maximum: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl with tracking-tight.
H2 Section headers: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl with tracking-tight.
Overlines/Eyebrows: uppercase, text-xs sm:text-sm, font-semibold, tracking-[0.2em], amber text.
Body text: text-base (mobile: text-sm), leading-relaxed for high readability.
Tinted Greys: Never use pure black #000000. Use tinting with #0B132B or #0F172A.
Gradient usage: Maximum 10% coverage across pages. No generic dark gradients background.
Header background: Use glassmorphism with explicit background overlay like bg-white/90 backdrop-blur-md or bg-[#0B132B]/90. Fully transparent header is FORBIDDEN.

layout_and_spacing.system: Tailwind generous scale (p-6, p-8, p-12, py-20, py-28)
layout_and_spacing.bento_grid: The Tetris Grid protocol for event formats & stats section (mix of 8-col hero, 4-col square, 4-col tall cards)
layout_and_spacing.alignment: Asymmetrical hero with left-aligned editorial content, center-balanced section headers
layout_and_spacing.whitespace: Mandatory 2x-3x padding to give institutional weight to every card and section container.

motion_and_effects.entrance_animations: Framer motion staggered fade-in-up for cards, speakers, and schedule items
motion_and_effects.stats_counters: Animated integer count-up on scroll visibility
motion_and_effects.marquee: Slow smooth drift marquee for partners, sponsors, and key quote ribbons
motion_and_effects.hover_states: Cards lift -translate-y-1.5 with shadow-xl and subtle border glow on hover

testing_and_accessibility.data_testid_requirement: All interactive buttons, filter tabs, inputs, modal triggers, and nav links MUST include kebab-case data-testid attributes (e.g. data-testid='hero-register-button', data-testid='program-day-1-tab', data-testid='speaker-card-modal-trigger').
testing_and_accessibility.language_switch: Include FR/EN state toggle with all text content responsive to language state.

instructions_to_main_agent: Use JavaScript / JSX files (.js / .jsx) as configured in the frontend repository.
Implement the SEIM brand logo with deep navy text and amber zigzag arrow mark.
Never build a dark-only template: use light neutral backgrounds (#F8FAFC) for high readability, contrasted with deep navy section blocks (#0B132B) for high-impact statements.
Strictly attach data-testid attributes to all actionable components.
Ensure 100% responsiveness with flawless mobile navigation and smooth interactive filters.
